j-topup.title: Home entry 5 · Add funds
j-topup.summary: Entry point: Add funds on the Home wallet card. Alex adds UGX 75,000 to the LoadMaster wallet with Airtel Money. The demo approves instantly; the balance on Home updates and operations sees the top-up in the money ledger.

steps.label: Home · entry point. The wallet card shows the balance (the eye hides it) and Add funds. Next: tap Add funds.
Add funds sheet: wallet balance, amount, payment method (MTN, Airtel, demo card) and the demo outcome (Success, Pending, Failed). Next: enter an amount.
UGX 75,000 entered and Airtel Money chosen. Next: Approve demo top-up.
Top-up approved: success confirmation with the new balance.
POST /account/wallet · wallet_topup posted to the ledger (customer wallet ← Airtel Money)
Close the sheet: Home shows the new balance.
Admin · Transfers ledger lists the wallet top-up.
Admin · Collections and reconciliation stay balanced.

j-payout.title: Driver is paid out
j-payout.summary: Brian withdraws UGX 150,000 of unpaid earnings to Airtel Money. Operations reviews the request and approves it for finance payment; Brian sees the request move on in the app.

steps.label: Earnings shows scheduled (unpaid) earnings.
Open payout requests: choose an amount and a payout platform.
Enter UGX 150,000 and pick Airtel Money.
Request withdrawal: confirmation.
POST /account/withdrawal · earnings moved to withdrawal clearing; request pending review
The request is listed under Your requests as pending.
Driver payouts lists the new request.
Review request: Approve for finance payment, with a reason for the audit trail.
Save: the payout is approved for finance payment.
Brian's payout request shows the new status.

j-driver-onboarding.title: New driver registers and gets verified
j-driver-onboarding.summary: Grace creates a driver account, confirms the demo code, adds her truck and submits the four required documents. Operations approves each document and then the driver, after which Grace can go online.

steps.label: Driver app sign-in. Tap Create account.
Registration form.
Fill name, phone, email and password.
Create account: enter the demo verification code.
Verify & continue: Home asks for verification before going online.
Account › Vehicle & verification: nothing submitted yet.
Edit vehicle details: model and licence plate.
Submit vehicle for review.
POST /account/document ×4 · Driver licence, Identity document, Vehicle registration, Third-party insurance (photos picked on the phone)
All four documents submitted: awaiting review.
Drivers list: Grace is awaiting review.
Driver page: vehicle and documents to review.
Documents tab › Review the driver licence: Approve, with a note.
Save, then approve the other three documents the same way.
Approve driver & vehicle.
Confirm: Grace is an approved driver.
Vehicle & verification now shows Grace as approved.
Home: verified, Grace can go online.

j-customer-signup.title: New customer creates an account
j-customer-signup.summary: A new customer registers in the customer app, confirms the demo code and lands on Home ready to order a truck.

steps.label: Customer app sign-in. Tap Create account.
Registration form.
Fill name, phone, email and password.
Create account: enter the demo verification code.
Verify & continue: Home, ready to order.

j-trip-reassign.title: Operations reassigns a trip to another driver
j-trip-reassign.summary: Brian has accepted Alex's trip but cannot make the pickup. Operations opens the trip, reassigns it to Grace with a reason, and both apps update: Brian's request is withdrawn and Alex sees the new driver.

steps.label: Trips: find LM-8895AB7C (assigned to Brian).
Open the trip page.
Manage assignment: choose Grace and give a reason.
Save: Grace is the assigned driver.
Driver requests: Brian's acceptance withdrawn, Grace assigned by operations.
Brian's Updates: the order was reassigned.
Alex's order shows Grace as the driver.

j-account-suspension.title: Operations suspends and reactivates a driver
j-account-suspension.summary: A driver account is suspended with a reason (signed out everywhere, no requests), the action is recorded in the audit trail, and the account is reactivated later.

steps.label: Drivers: find Harriet.
Driver page.
More actions menu.
Suspend account: give a reason.
Save: Harriet is suspended.
Audit trail records who suspended her and why.
Back on the driver page: More › Reactivate account.
Save: Harriet is active again.

j-support-case.title: Customer raises a support case and operations resolves it
j-support-case.summary: Alex reports a problem from the customer app. Customer care finds the case, replies and marks it resolved; Alex sees the reply in Your support cases.

steps.label: Account tab: Help & support.
Contact demo support: describe the issue.
Send support request: the case is recorded.
POST /account/ticket · case created (open) and visible to operations
Support: the new open case.
Reply / resolve: write the reply and set Resolved.
Save: the case is resolved.
Your support cases: resolved, with the reply.

j-reconciliation.title: Finance reconciles a provider settlement report
j-reconciliation.summary: Finance imports the mobile-money provider's settlement report. LoadMaster compares every line with its own collections and lists matches, amount differences and unknown references for follow-up.

steps.label: Reconciliation: earlier imports.
Import report: collections, paste the provider's CSV.
Compare records: matches, an amount difference and an unknown reference.
Open the import to see every line.

j-staff-invite.title: Super Admin invites a staff member
j-staff-invite.summary: Irene invites a new customer-care agent. The account is created with a temporary password that must be changed at first sign-in; the role decides which sections they see.

steps.label: Staff & roles.
Invite staff: name, email, phone and role.
Save: the temporary password is shown once.
Ruth is listed with setup pending.

j-pricing.title: Operations changes the driver response window
j-pricing.summary: Settings › Edit pricing rules: the response window goes from 45 to 60 seconds with a reason; new requests to drivers use the new countdown.

steps.label: Settings: pricing and dispatch rules.
Edit pricing rules: response window 60 seconds, with a reason.
Save: the new window applies to new requests.
The audit trail records the change.

j-home-order.title: Home entry 1 · Order a cargo truck
j-home-order.summary: Entry point: the green Order a cargo truck button on Home. Alex sets pickup and destination, picks a truck, adds cargo and contacts, chooses how to pay, reviews and places the order. LoadMaster offers it to eligible online drivers; Brian accepts in the driver app and Alex sees the assigned driver.

steps.label: Home · entry point. The green Order a cargo truck button (“Set pickup and destination”) starts an immediate order. Next: tap it.
Locations: map with the pickup pin, “Where is the cargo?” and “Where is it going?” prefilled from saved places, plus recent destinations. Next: Continue.
Step 1 of 4 · Truck & destinations: the route, truck sizes (Pickup, Medium, Large), loading helpers at pickup, delivery stops (up to 5) and the estimated total. Next: choose a truck.
Medium truck selected (up to 3 tonnes, covered): the estimated total updates. Next: Cargo & contacts.

Step 2 of 4 · Cargo & contacts: sender (you by default or someone else), cargo items with weight against the truck payload, the recipient at each stop and an optional handover PIN. Next: Payment & pairing.
Step 3 of 4 · Payment & pairing: who pays (you, or the recipient after handover), the payment method and optional pairing with a known driver. Next: Review order.
Step 4 of 4 · Review your order: route, contacts, cargo, the fee breakdown, payer, method and matching. Tick the acknowledgement to enable Order a truck.
The acknowledgement is ticked; the total and Order a truck are ready at the bottom.
Order placed: confirmation with the order number; LoadMaster is finding a driver. Next: Track my order.
POST /orders · order created as Finding a driver and offered to eligible online drivers, one at a time, each with a response countdown
Order screen · Finding a driver: route map, stops, cargo, delivery progress, payment and Cancel order while the cargo is not collected.
Driver app · Brian taps Review request: pickup, stops, cargo, truck, his earning and the response countdown.
Driver app · Accept this order: the trip is Brian's and moves to his Deliveries.
Customer app · the order now shows Brian as the driver, his truck and the handover codes.
Messages & quick replies: chat with the assigned driver about this order, with one-tap quick replies.

j-home-schedule.title: Home entry 2 · Schedule pickup
j-home-schedule.summary: Entry point: the Schedule pickup tile on Home. Same order wizard as Order a cargo truck, with a pickup date and time chosen up front. The order is saved as scheduled and dispatched to drivers closer to the pickup time.

steps.label: Home · entry point. The Schedule pickup tile (first of the three shortcuts) books a truck for later. Next: tap it.
Locations · “Schedule your pickup.”: pickup and destination plus Pickup date & time, with Change date and Change time. Next: Continue.
Step 1 of 4 · Truck & destinations for the scheduled trip: route, truck size, helpers, stops and estimate. Next: Cargo & contacts.

Step 2 of 4 · Cargo & contacts: sender (you by default or someone else), cargo items with weight against the truck payload, the recipient at each stop and an optional handover PIN. Next: Payment & pairing.
Step 3 of 4 · Payment & pairing: who pays (you, or the recipient after handover), the payment method and optional pairing with a known driver. Next: Review order.
Step 4 of 4 · Review your order: route, contacts, cargo, the fee breakdown, payer, method and matching. Tick the acknowledgement to enable Order a truck.
The acknowledgement is ticked; the total and Order a truck are ready at the bottom.
Pickup scheduled: the order number is booked and LoadMaster starts finding a driver before pickup. Next: Track my order.
POST /orders (scheduledAt) · order saved as Scheduled; dispatch to drivers starts near the pickup time
Order screen · Scheduled: the scheduled pickup date and time; eligible drivers receive the request when it is due.
Orders tab lists the trip as Scheduled.

j-home-repeat.title: Home entry 3 · Order again
j-home-repeat.summary: Entry point: the Order again tile on Home. Alex picks a past trip; its route, cargo and contacts are copied into the order wizard to review and edit, and a fresh price is calculated before ordering.

steps.label: Home · entry point. The Order again tile (middle shortcut) repeats a past trip. Next: tap it.
Order again: completed, returned and cancelled trips, newest first, each with route, date, status and price. Next: choose a trip.
A delivered trip is chosen: Locations opens prefilled with its pickup and destination. Next: Continue.
Step 1 of 4 · the past trip's truck, loading helpers and stops are preselected; a fresh estimate is shown. Next: Cargo & contacts.
Step 2 of 4 · cargo items, sender and recipients copied from the past trip, ready to edit. Next: Payment & pairing.
Step 3 of 4 · the past trip's payment method is preselected. Next: Review order.
Step 4 of 4 · Review your order: route, contacts, cargo, the fee breakdown, payer, method and matching. Tick the acknowledgement to enable Order a truck.
The acknowledgement is ticked; the total and Order a truck are ready at the bottom.
Order placed: confirmation with the new order number. Next: Track my order.
POST /orders · a new order with a fresh quote; the past trip is unchanged
Order screen · Finding a driver for the repeated trip.

j-home-driver-id.title: Home entry 4 · Use a driver ID
j-home-driver-id.summary: Entry point: the Use a driver ID tile on Home. Alex enters a driver's short number (Brian is 2001). LoadMaster checks the driver is verified, online, free and has a big enough truck, then the order goes to that driver first; Brian accepts and is assigned.

steps.label: Home · entry point. The Use a driver ID tile (third shortcut) sends an order straight to a driver you know. Next: tap it.
Use a driver ID: Driver number or ID field; the order goes to this driver for acceptance. Next: enter the number.
Unknown number: “Check the driver's short number.” Nothing is sent until a valid driver is found.
POST /account/pair · resolves the short number; refuses drivers who are offline, busy, unverified or whose truck is too small (8 attempts a minute)
Brian (2001) is available: Locations opens with his truck size carried over. Next: Continue.
Step 1 of 4 · Truck & destinations, preset to Brian's truck size. Next: Cargo & contacts.

Step 2 of 4 · Cargo & contacts: sender (you by default or someone else), cargo items with weight against the truck payload, the recipient at each stop and an optional handover PIN. Next: Payment & pairing.
Step 3 of 4 · Your matched driver: Brian Kato with his truck and plate, awaiting his consent after ordering. Use automatic matching switches back. Next: Review order.
Step 4 of 4 · Review your order shows “Pair with Brian Kato” as matching. Tick the acknowledgement.
The acknowledgement is ticked; the total and Order a truck are ready at the bottom.
Order placed. Next: Track my order.
Order screen · Awaiting your paired driver: only Brian is asked; Search other eligible drivers falls back to automatic matching.
Driver app · Brian's request is marked as paired to him. Review request shows the trip and countdown.
Driver app · Accept this order.
Customer app · Brian is the assigned driver.

j-home-loyalty.title: Home entry 6 · Loyalty rewards
j-home-loyalty.summary: Entry point: the Loyalty & referral rewards banner on Home. Alex reads how loyalty rewards work. Finance then gives Alex a cashback for a completed trip; it is paid into the LoadMaster wallet, listed under Referrals & rewards and can be spent by choosing LoadMaster wallet at payment.

steps.label: Home · entry point. The Loyalty & referral rewards banner at the bottom of Home. Next: tap it.
Offer card · “More value with LoadMaster”: approved referral and cashback rewards are credited to the LoadMaster wallet and used by choosing LoadMaster wallet at payment. Next: Got it.
Back on Home.
Admin · Referrals & cashbacks: every reward with status.
Admin · New reward: Alex, Customer cashback, the completed trip, UGX 5,000 and a reason.
Admin · Saved: the cashback is pending.
Admin · Pay reward: confirm with a note.
Admin · Paid: the cashback is credited to Alex's wallet.
POST /admin/reward · reward posted to the ledger (customer wallet ← platform)
Customer · Account › Referrals & rewards lists the new Customer cashback as paid, with its reason.
Customer · Home: the wallet balance includes the cashback.
Using it: at Step 3 · Payment, choose LoadMaster wallet to pay from the balance.

j-home-referral.title: Home entry 7 · Referral
j-home-referral.summary: Entry point: the Loyalty & referral rewards banner, then Account › Referrals & rewards. Alex shares a personal referral code. When the referred friend completes a trip, operations records a referral bonus and pays it into Alex's LoadMaster wallet.

steps.label: Home · entry point. Loyalty & referral rewards banner; referrals are managed from Account. Next: Account tab.
Account › More account options lists Referrals & rewards. Next: tap it.
Referrals & rewards · “A good move is worth sharing.”: Alex's referral code, Preview loyalty offer card, Share referral code and past reward records.
Share referral code opens the phone's share sheet with “My LoadMaster demo referral code is LM-…”. The friend signs up and completes a trip.
Admin · Referrals & cashbacks.
Admin · New reward: Alex, Referral bonus, the qualifying completed trip, UGX 10,000 and a reason.
Admin · Saved: the referral bonus is pending.
Customer · Referrals & rewards: the referral bonus shows as pending.
Admin · Pay reward: confirm with a note.
Admin · Paid into Alex's wallet.
Customer · Referrals & rewards: the referral bonus is paid.
Customer · Home: the wallet balance includes the bonus.
